properties.notes: Site of former fire station that was declared surplus and sold by NCC. Clearance required prior to a small infill development progressing. Permission granted demolition of the vacant buildings followed by construction of 5 homes (17/02577/FUL). Development of 5 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
properties.site-address: Haydon Bridge Fire Station, Station Road, Haydon Road
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
